message.content:
```yaml
code_suggestions:
- relevant_file: |
    skills/engineering-manager/scripts/review-packet/review_packet/model.clj
  language: |
    clojure
  existing_code: |
    packet (cond-> packet
             since-review (assoc-array :since-review (since-facts since-review step-paths files hunk-index))
             (chain-break chain since-review remote) (assoc-array :chain-break (chain-break chain since-review remote))
             (seq history) (assoc-array :history (vec history)))]
  suggestion_content: |
    `(chain-break chain since-review remote)` is computed twice, once as the `cond->` test and again as the value to assoc. Bind it once to a local to avoid redundant work and guarantee both uses see the exact same value.
  improved_code: |
    cb (chain-break chain since-review remote)
    packet (cond-> packet
             since-review (assoc-array :since-review (since-facts since-review step-paths files hunk-index))
             cb (assoc-array :chain-break cb)
             (seq history) (assoc-array :history (vec history)))]
  one_sentence_summary: |
    Avoid duplicate computation of chain-break.
  label: |
    general

- relevant_file: |
    skills/engineering-manager/scripts/kk-packet-approval.sh
  language: |
    bash
  existing_code: |
    force-push)
        # Only the remote head this packet recorded on a chain break, and only while
        # it is still this ticket's newest packet: kk-approval decides the rest.
        facts=$(kk-approval status "$ticket" --output json "${ws[@]+"${ws[@]}"}") || exit $?
        jq -e --arg p "$pid" --arg l "$lease" --arg h "$head" \
           '.packet == $p and .packet_facts.chain_break != null and .packet_facts.remote_head == $l and $l != $h' \
           <<< "$facts" >/dev/null \
          || fail "force-push needs a chain-break packet and, as its lease, the remote head that packet recorded"
        actions=(--action force-push --lease "$lease") ;;
  suggestion_content: |
    A force-push with an empty `$lease` currently relies entirely on the jq equality check failing against the recorded `remote_head` to be rejected; this is implicit and fragile for such a security-sensitive operation (overwriting remote history). Add an explicit, clear precondition that `$lease` must be non-empty before attempting the match.
  improved_code: |
    force-push)
        [ -n "$lease" ] || fail "force-push requires a lease"
        # Only the remote head this packet recorded on a chain break, and only while
        # it is still this ticket's newest packet: kk-approval decides the rest.
        facts=$(kk-approval status "$ticket" --output json "${ws[@]+"${ws[@]}"}") || exit $?
        jq -e --arg p "$pid" --arg l "$lease" --arg h "$head" \
           '.packet == $p and .packet_facts.chain_break != null and .packet_facts.remote_head == $l and $l != $h' \
           <<< "$facts" >/dev/null \
          || fail "force-push needs a chain-break packet and, as its lease, the remote head that packet recorded"
        actions=(--action force-push --lease "$lease") ;;
  one_sentence_summary: |
    Explicitly require a lease for force-push.
  label: |
    critical bug

- relevant_file: |
    skills/engineering-manager/scripts/kk-review-packet.sh
  language: |
    bash
  existing_code: |
    chain_args=()
    if [ -n "$predecessor" ] && [ -n "$head_branch" ]; then
      chain_args+=(--remote-ref "origin/$head_branch")
      if remote_head=$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse --verify --quiet "refs/remotes/origin/$head_branch^{commit}" 2>/dev/null); then
        chain_args+=(--remote-head "$remote_head")
      fi
    fi
  suggestion_content: |
    The remote is hardcoded as `origin`, which will silently produce an empty/incorrect `remote-ref`/`remote-head` (and thus skip the chain-break force-push path) for repositories whose tracking remote has a different name. Resolve the actual configured remote for the branch, falling back to `origin`.
  improved_code: |
    chain_args=()
    if [ -n "$predecessor" ] && [ -n "$head_branch" ]; then
      remote_name=$(git -C "$repo" config --get "branch.$head_branch.remote" 2>/dev/null)
      remote_name=${remote_name:-origin}
      chain_args+=(--remote-ref "$remote_name/$head_branch")
      if remote_head=$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse --verify --quiet "refs/remotes/$remote_name/$head_branch^{commit}" 2>/dev/null); then
        chain_args+=(--remote-head "$remote_head")
      fi
    fi
  one_sentence_summary: |
    Don't hardcode the remote name.
  label: |
    general
```
